parameters.description: Multiple values can be provided by separating them with a comma. Allowed values are: `scheduled`, `active`, `expired`, `cancelled`.
parameters.name: status

parameters.description: The page of results to return. Defaults to 1 if not provided.
parameters.name: page

schema.description: The page of results to return. Defaults to 1 if not provided.

parameters.description: The number of results to return per page. Defaults to 10 if not provided. Maximum value is 100.
parameters.name: page_size

schema.description: The number of results to return per page. Defaults to 10 if not provided. Maximum value is 100.

parameters.description: The target platform id. Required only when calling with a dashboard (WorkOS AuthKit) access token instead of a platform API key — the token carries no platform claim, so the caller must say which platform it means. Ignored for platform API key / embed session token callers.
parameters.name: X-Platform-Id

has_next_page.description: Whether there are more pages available after this page

has_previous_page.description: Whether there are more pages available before this page

items.description: A paginated array containing the response elements

cancellation_date.description: Policy cancellation date (inclusive) in ISO 8610 (YYYY-MM-DD), or null if not applicable.

disclosures.description: Disclosures associated with this group policy.

type.description: The specific type of disclosure within its category.

employer_id.description: Identifier for the employer associated with this group policy.

end_date.description: Policy end date (inclusive) in ISO 8601 (YYYY-MM-DD), or null if open-ended.

group_id.description: Identifier for the group associated with this group policy.

family_type.description: Type of the family covered by the employer.

adults.description: Number of additional adults covered, including partner/spouse.

member_count.description: Numbers of additional members covered by the employer.

member_selection.description: Whether specific member types are covered by the employer.

percentage.description:
Employer coverage percentage:
 For 40% send 40.
 For 100% send 100.
Percentage of the premium the employer covers.

type.description: Cost sharing type. Determines which sub-object is populated.

cost_sharing.description: Defines how the policies total cost is shared between employer and employee.

configuration.description: How the policy is configured by default, such as cost sharing and other options.

group_policy_number.description: Provider-issued policy number. May be null if not yet issued.

renewed_policy_id.description: Identifier of the renewed policy. This means existing policy will be replaced by the renewed policy on the renewal date.

id.description: Unique identifier for the group policy. Prefixed with `gp_`.

currency.description: ISO 4217 currency code for pricing under this plan.

documents.description: List of plan documents (e.g., IPIDs, T&Cs).

link.description: Public URL to the document. This could be any format (PDF, HTML, etc.).

type.description: Machine-readable document kind used for display and i18n. Possible values are listed below; as this enum can expand with new benefits, unknown values MUST be handled gracefully by clients (fallback to a generic `document` label).

id.description: Unique identifier for the plan. Prefixed with pl_.

employee_portal_url.description: URL for the employee portal (may include claims management).

id.description: Unique identifier for the provider. Prefixed with pr_.

support_phone_number.description: Provider support phone number in E.164 format.

status.description:
Current lifecycle state of the `group_policy`, indicating its progress from creation to activation. Possible values are:
 - `scheduled`: Group policy has been scheduled for activation.
 - `active`: Group policy is now active
 - `expired`: Group policy is no longer active as it reached its end date
 - `cancelled`: Group policy is now cancelled for any reason.

type.description: Policy type. Determines which sub-object is populated.

page.description: The current page of the results

page_size.description: The number of results on this page. This can be different from the requested page size if the total number of results is less than the requested page size

total_count.description: The total number of elements available in the response. This is the total number of elements available across all pages, not just the current page.
